mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.bill_no, b.bill_type, b.bill_month, b.bill_amount, b.payable_amount, b.current_cost, b.deposit_amount, b.prepaid_amount, b.transaction_status, b.create_time, b.payment_deadline, b.bill_start_time, b.bill_end_time, b.total_days, b.lname, b.type_name, b.remark, e.name AS elder_name, e.id_card_no AS elder_id_card_no, e.image AS elder_image, cic.bed_cost, cic.nursing_cost, cic.other_cost, cic.medical_insurance_payment, cic.government_subsidy, cic.cost_start_time AS cost_start_time, COALESCE(cic.bed_cost, 0) + COALESCE(cic.nursing_cost, 0) + COALESCE(cic.other_cost, 0) - COALESCE(cic.medical_insurance_payment, 0) - COALESCE(cic.government_subsidy, 0) AS month_cost, COALESCE(cic.bed_cost, 0) + COALESCE(cic.nursing_cost, 0) + COALESCE(cic.other_cost, 0) AS add1, COALESCE(cic.medical_insurance_payment, 0) + COALESCE(cic.government_subsidy, 0) AS add2, creator.real_name AS creator, m.name AS memberCreator, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.id AS orderId FROM bill b LEFT JOIN elder e ON b.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN check_in_config cic ON b.elder_id = cic.elder_id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON b.create_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN `order` o ON b.trading_order_no = o.trading_order_no AND b.trading_order_no > 0 LEFT JOIN `member` m ON o.member_id = m.id WHERE b.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bill ( bill_no, bill_type, bill_month, elder_id, bill_amount, payable_amount, current_cost, deposit_amount, prepaid_amount, payment_deadline, transaction_status, bill_start_time, bill_end_time, total_days, lname, type_name, create_time, create_by ) VALUES ( #{billNo}, #{billType}, #{billMonth}, #{elderId}, #{billAmount}, #{payableAmount}, #{currentCost}, #{depositAmount}, #{prepaidAmount}, #{paymentDeadline}, #{transactionStatus}, #{billStartTime}, #{billEndTime}, #{totalDays}, #{lname}, #{typeName}, NOW(), #{createBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE `bill` SET transaction_status = #{transactionStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, bill_no, trading_order_no, bill_type, bill_month, elder_id, bill_amount, payable_amount, prepaid_amount, deposit_amount, current_cost, payment_deadline, transaction_status, bill_start_time, bill_end_time, total_days, create_time, lname, type_name, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark FROM `bill` WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT b.id, b.bill_no AS billNo, b.bill_type AS billType, b.bill_month AS billMonth, b.bill_amount AS billAmount, b.payable_amount AS payableAmount, b.transaction_status AS transactionStatus, b.create_time AS createTime, b.payment_deadline AS paymentDeadline, e.name AS elderName, e.id_card_no AS elderIdCardNo FROM bill b LEFT JOIN elder e ON b.elder_id = e.id WHERE 1 = 1
AND b.transaction_status = #{transactionStatus}
AND b.bill_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{billNo}, '%')
AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{elderName}, '%')
AND e.id_card_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{elderIdCard}, '%')
ORDER BY b.create_time DESC

SELECT b.id, b.bill_no AS billNo, b.bill_month AS billMonth, b.payable_amount AS payableAmount, b.payment_deadline AS paymentDeadline, COALESCE(SUM(b.payable_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY b.elder_id), b.payable_amount) AS total, e.name AS elderName, e.bed_number AS bedNumber FROM bill b INNER JOIN elder e ON b.elder_id = e.id WHERE b.transaction_status = 0
AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{elderName}, '%')
ORDER BY b.payment_deadline ASC

SELECT pr.id, pr.prepaid_recharge_no AS prepaidRechargeNo, pr.recharge_amount AS rechargeAmount, pr.recharge_voucher AS rechargeVoucher, pr.recharge_method AS rechargeMethod, pr.remark, pr.create_time AS createTime, e.name AS elderName, e.bed_number AS bedNo, creator.real_name AS creator FROM prepaid_recharge_record pr INNER JOIN elder e ON pr.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON pr.create_by = creator.id WHERE 1 = 1
AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{elderName}, '%')
ORDER BY pr.create_time DESC

SELECT bal.id, bal.elder_name AS elderName, bal.bed_no AS bedNo, bal.prepaid_balance AS prepaidBalance, bal.deposit_amount AS depositAmount, bal.arrears_amount AS arrearsAmount, bal.update_time AS updateTime FROM balance bal WHERE 1 = 1
AND bal.elder_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{elderName}, '%')
ORDER BY bal.update_time DESC

SELECT b.bill_no AS code, b.bill_type AS type, b.bill_month AS billMonth, b.payable_amount AS amount FROM bill b WHERE b.elder_id = #{elderId} AND b.transaction_status = 0 AND b.bill_type = 0 ORDER BY b.bill_month ASC
SELECT b.bill_no AS code, b.lname AS nursingName, b.payable_amount AS amount FROM bill b WHERE b.elder_id = #{elderId} AND b.transaction_status = 0 AND b.bill_type = 1 ORDER BY b.create_time ASC

SELECT b.bill_no AS code, b.bill_type AS type, b.bill_month AS billMonth, b.payable_amount AS amount, b.lname AS nursingName, b.total_days AS totalDays, DATEDIFF(b.bill_end_time, #{checkOutTime}) AS dueBackDay, DATEDIFF(#{checkOutTime}, b.bill_start_time) AS realDay FROM bill b WHERE b.elder_id = #{elderId} AND b.transaction_status = 1 AND b.bill_type = 0 AND b.bill_end_time > #{checkOutTime} ORDER BY b.bill_month ASC
SELECT id, prepaid_balance AS prepaidBalance, deposit_amount AS depositAmount, arrears_amount AS arrearsAmount, elder_name AS elderName FROM balance WHERE elder_id = #{elderId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE balance SET prepaid_balance = prepaid_balance + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE elder_id = #{elderId}
